visual_action: Vice President Kamala Harris stands at a podium with American flags in the background, delivering a speech to an audience that is heard applauding but not seen. The video is a single, static, medium shot of Harris from the waist up.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Is the sole person on screen, delivering a speech directly to the camera/audience.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the central subject of Kamala Harris's speech. She says, 'Donald Trump is increasingly unstable and unhinged' and 'Donald Trump is unfit to serve.'

cast.name: Mike Pence
cast.evidence: Kamala Harris refers to former officials who have warned against Trump, including 'his own vice president'.

on_screen_text.text: VP Harris: Trump is seeking unchecked power

spoken_summary: Kamala Harris states that Donald Trump is 'increasingly unstable and unhinged' and is 'seeking unchecked power.' She cites warnings against him from his own former officials, including his national security adviser, two defense secretaries, his former chief of staff, and his own vice president, concluding they have all warned America that 'Donald Trump is unfit to serve.' The audience applauds her statements.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of Kamala Harris's speech and the sounds of an audience clapping in response.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static talking-head shot. The only editing is the sequential appearance of large, yellow text captions that reinforce the words being spoken.
central_claim: Donald Trump is mentally unstable, seeks unchecked power, and is considered unfit for office even by his own former top advisors.
intended_effect: To persuade viewers that Donald Trump is a dangerous and unfit candidate for the presidency by using his former colleagues' alleged warnings as evidence.
